digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime auth injection into ProviderSession
propositions: Add LLMRuntime capability type to accept provider-native auth/session inputs (boto3 Session, Anthropic token provider, OpenAI workload identity) without serializing or exposing credentials in config/request/cache/schema/output
Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to receive and pass LLMRuntime into the single per-run ProviderSession builder, enriching only Anthropic/Bedrock/OpenAI client construction
Ensure exactly one Rebar-owned official client is constructed and closed per run, with provider SDK retaining native auth precedence, refresh, and workload identity
Reject missing or conflicting explicit auth before any provider model request, with no fallback to anonymous or cross-provider principals
Preserve RP-01 authoritative Agent operation, budget, cache, exhaustion, output retry, artifact, tracing, usage, and failure contracts unchanged
Live authenticated Bedrock/Anthropic canary via AWS review bot and GitHub CI confirms auth injection path functions end-to-end without credential leakage
